Connection: Open, close, and inspect owned ADBC connections; refresh attached catalog metadata.
Query: Read arbitrary SQL results with adbc_scan or named tables with adbc_scan_table.
Mutation: Execute remote DDL/DML with CALL adbc_execute, or ingest Arrow batches with adbc_insert.
Transactions: Use CALL to set autocommit, commit, or roll back on an explicit connection handle.
Schema: Inspect tables, columns, table types, and named-table Arrow schemas through driver metadata APIs.
